label: Texture pack
description: Changes the base textures immediately. The individual weather, cobblestone and brick overrides apply on top of any pack.

label: Music
description: Volume of background music and records, before master and per-track volume.

label: Sound effects
description: Volume of game sounds, before master and category volume.

label: Sensitivity
description: Mouse turning speed. 100 is Minecraft's standard sensitivity.

label: Invert mouse
description: Reverses vertical mouse movement when looking around.

label: View bobbing
description: Moves the first-person camera as you walk.

label: 3D anaglyph
description: Renders red/cyan stereo for anaglyph glasses.

label: Advanced OpenGL
description: Skips hidden geometry using GPU occlusion queries. Benefits depend on your graphics driver.

label: Smooth lighting
description: Softens lighting across block corners instead of flat lighting per face.

label: Fancy graphics
description: Uses transparent leaves and more detailed clouds and rendering.

label: Difficulty
description: Controls hostile mobs and damage. Peaceful removes hostile mobs and restores health.

label: Field of view
description: Camera angle in degrees. Higher values show more scenery and make the player look smaller in third person.

label: Brightness
description: Brightens dark areas without changing block light levels or mob spawning.

label: Cloud height
description: Altitude of the cloud layer in blocks.

label: Fog density
description: Amount of distance fog. 100 is normal; 0 removes it.

label: Render distance, chunks
description: Maximum terrain draw distance in chunks. Higher values use more memory and processing time.

label: Frame limit, 300 is unlimited
description: Maximum frames per second. 300 removes the cap; lower values reduce GPU use.

label: GUI scale
description: Resizes menus and the HUD immediately. Auto uses the largest scale that fits. The minimum menu size is 320 x 240, so larger scales may look identical in a small window.

label: Clouds
description: Draws the cloud layer in the sky.

label: Forward
description: Move forward.

label: Left
description: Strafe left.

label: Back
description: Move backward.

label: Right
description: Strafe right.

label: Jump
description: Jump, swim upward or ascend while flying.

label: Sneak
description: Sneak at ledges or descend while flying.

label: Drop
description: Drop one item from the selected hotbar slot.

label: Inventory
description: Open or close your inventory.

label: Chat
description: Open chat to write a message or command.

label: Toggle Fog
description: Cycle Far, Normal, Short and Tiny terrain distance. Shift reverses the cycle.

label: Preview container contents
description: Hold while aiming at a container to preview its contents without opening it.

label: Toggle freecam
description: Detach the camera from your player. Press again to return.

label: Toggle player movement
description: Allow or stop player movement while the camera is detached.

label: Change freecam speed
description: Hold and scroll to adjust detached-camera movement speed.

label: Save or load camera position

label: Open camera position gui
description: Manage saved camera positions for the current world.

label: Custom photo
description: Capture the view at the configured screenshot resolution.

label: Isometric photo

label: Dismount
description: Leave the boat, minecart or other vehicle you are riding.

label: Zoom
description: Hold to zoom the camera; scroll to adjust magnification.

label: Photo Mode
description: Open photo controls for camera position, framing and capture.

label: Hide HUD
description: Toggle the crosshair, hotbar and other HUD elements.

label: Take Screenshot
description: Save a screenshot of the current view.

label: Debug HUD

label: Third Person
description: Cycle between first-person and configured third-person views.

label: Cinematic Camera
description: Toggle smoothed mouse movement for camera pans.

label: Toggle Fullscreen
description: Switch between windowed and fullscreen display.

label: Release Mouse
description: Release the mouse pointer from the game window.

label: Player list

label: Flexible placement (toggle)

label: Slab completion (toggle)

label: Free look

label: Slash opens chat
description: Open chat with / already entered when pressing the slash key.

label: Move containers
description: Sneak and use an empty hand to pick up a chest, furnace or dispenser. Use again to place it. Contents are saved in a recovery journal.

label: Container preview
description: Hold the container-preview key while aiming at a container to view its contents without opening it.

label: Camera distance
description: Distance behind the player in blocks. Walls can move the camera closer; 4 is vanilla.

label: Fast placement
description: Hold right-click to keep placing blocks.

label: Placement attempts per tick
description: Maximum placement attempts per game tick.

label: Remember orientation
description: Keep the initial orientation during continuous placement.

label: Vertical slab placement
description: Continuous layers, double slabs, or repeat the first slab configuration.

label: Placement restriction
description: Constrain continued placement using the first successful placement.

label: Tie restriction to fast placement
description: Turning fast placement on or off also changes the restriction switch.

label: Restriction rule
description: Face, plane, layer, column, line or diagonal.

label: Item filter
description: Choose whether to allow all items, exclude listed items, or only allow listed items.

label: Excluded items
description: Item IDs separated by commas, for example 1, 44:2.

label: Allowed items
description: Item IDs separated by commas, for example 1, 44:2. An empty allow-list permits nothing.

label: Flexible placement
description: Enables placement hotkeys for moving the target position and changing block orientation.

label: Target face overlay
description: Draws selectable placement regions on the targeted block face while a placement key is held.

label: Destination preview
description: Outlines the block position that the current placement keys would use.

label: Place against containers
description: Allows placement against chests, furnaces and other interactive blocks while a placement key is held.

label: Overlay color
description: Tint used for the placement regions and destination outline.

label: Overlay opacity, %
description: Transparency of the placement preview. Higher values make it more visible.

label: Edge protection
description: Prevent walking off ledges without crouching or slowing down.

label: Edge-protection messages
description: Shows a chat message when edge protection is switched on or off.

label: Complete slabs through adjacent faces
description: Combines matching half slabs when clicking a neighboring face would place into the existing slab.

label: Slab-completion messages
description: Shows a chat message when adjacent-face slab completion is switched on or off.

label: Swap hotbar rows
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Scroll to choose a row
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Modifier + number selects row
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Row preview
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Horizontal offset
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Vertical offset
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Preview alignment
description: Swaps move existing stacks between slots. Inventory recovery records remain enabled.

label: Follow current third-person view
description: Keeps free look in third person when the camera is already in third person, even if First person is selected.

label: Auto walk
description: Keeps walking forward without holding the movement key. Use its key binding to switch it off.

label: Free look
description: Lets the camera turn independently of the player's movement and placement direction.

label: Free look activation
description: Hold requires keeping the free-look key down. Toggle stays active until the next press.

label: Free look perspective
description: Selects the camera view used during free look. Following the current third-person view can override this.

label: Faster boats
description: Raise the boat speed limit independently of steering.

label: Boat collision protection
description: Prevent boats from breaking when they hit blocks.

label: Boat steering
description: Steer boats directly using movement keys. Speed and collision protection are separate.

label: Faster minecarts
description: Raises the minecart speed limit. Faster carts need longer braking distances.

label: Continuous click mining
description: Remove the delay between breaking blocks in singleplayer.

label: Creative flight
description: Double-tap Jump to start flying. Jump rises; Sneak descends.

label: Stop flying on landing
description: Return to walking when you touch the ground.

label: Flight sprint
description: Use the sprint key to fly faster.

label: Sprint activation
description: Toggle keeps sprint flight active after releasing the key. Hold requires the key to stay down.

label: Flight speed, %
description: 100% matches the modern creative flight target.

label: Sprint speed, %
description: Multiplier applied while sprint flight is active.

label: Flight drift
description: 0 stops immediately when movement keys are released. 5 uses full modern-style drift.

label: Double-tap window, ticks
description: Maximum interval between Jump presses. 20 ticks is one second.

label: Gamemode picker
description: Hold F3, press F4 to cycle, then release F3 to select.

label: Scroll to change speed
description: Adjust spectator flight speed with the mouse wheel.

label: Show spectator speed
description: Display the current speed while it changes.

label: Spectator speed, %
description: Starting spectator movement speed.

label: Speed step, %
description: Speed change for each wheel step.

label: Block reach
description: Reach in blocks. Only applies in Creative.

label: Entity reach
description: Reach in blocks. Only applies in Creative.

label: Destroy slot
description: Drag items to the slot beside the hotbar to delete them.

label: Shift-click clears inventory
description: Shift-click the destroy slot to clear inventory and armor.

label: World editing
description: Master switch for all editor commands and wand actions.

label: Require Creative mode
description: Require Creative when the creative-mode system is available. A world override can change this rule.

label: Wand item ID
description: Numeric item ID used for selecting corners. 271 is a wooden axe.

label: Maximum blocks per edit
description: Reject edits above this limit before making changes.

label: Blocks processed per tick
description: Lower values keep large edits responsive.

label: Undo history
description: Maximum number of edit records kept in memory.

label: Selection wand
description: Left-click sets the first corner; right-click sets the second, while holding the wand.

label: Selection outline
description: Draws a box around the selected editing region.

label: Show through blocks
description: Keeps the selection outline visible behind solid blocks.

label: Outline color
description: Tint of the selection box.

label: Outline opacity, %
description: Visibility of the selection box. Higher values make it less transparent.

label: Outline width
description: Thickness of selection edges in screen pixels.

label: Enable entity culling
description: Skips drawing mobs, dropped items and other entities fully hidden behind solid blocks.

label: Enable block entity culling
description: Skips drawing signs and other block entities fully hidden behind solid blocks.

label: Culling statistics
description: Shows visible and culled object counts in the debug overlay.

label: F3 info y offset
description: Moves culling statistics vertically in the debug overlay, in GUI pixels.

label: Treat glass as opaque
description: Uses glass as an opaque blocker for visibility checks. This can hide objects that should be visible through glass.

label: Freecam
description: Allow the detached camera and its controls.

label: Freecam door collisions
description: With camera collisions enabled, also collide with doors and trapdoors. Off passes through them.

label: Freecam sprint
description: Boost camera speed with the flight sprint key. Uses the creative sprint multiplier and Hold/Toggle setting.

label: Freecam speed
description: Changing this value will change the speed of the freecam

label: Freecam drag
description: Changing this value will change the drag of the freecam, The lower the drag, the longer it takes for the camera to stop. This option doesn't do anything for classic movement

label: Freecam collisions
description: Stops the detached camera at solid blocks. Off allows flying through them.

label: Show freecam
description: When this option is enabled, a 3D camera is rendered at the position of the freecam

label: Classic freecam movement
description: When this option is enabled the freecam will move like in older versions of Freecam

label: Custom screenshot height in pixels

label: Custom screenshot width in pixels
